Agents that share one store can see who changed what, and a human settles a disagreement.

- A write needs an actor and a lease (`acquire_lease`, then the write, then `release_lease`). Without them the write is refused and nothing is stored. Reads do not need a lease. A lease lasts 5 minutes by default and never longer than 1 hour.
- Every write is logged with the actor, an optional reason and topic, and the content before and after, so it can be rolled back.
- `declare_intent` finds a contradiction early. After two insisted rounds the topic is escalated. A human settles it at `/settlement` and can revert the writes that lost.
- Notices come back on the agent's next call. There is no push.
- The browser no longer creates or edits canvases. The library is Open, Code, and Copy link. Code view is read-only. Agents write the source over MCP.
